parts.title: Photographs
parts.instructions: Select the one statement that best describes what you see in the picture.

paragraphs.text: Directions: For each question in this part, you will hear four statements about a picture in your test book. When you hear the statements, you must select the one statement that best describes what you see in the picture. Then find the number of the question on your answer sheet and mark your answer. The statements will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.

parts.title: Conversations
parts.instructions: Select the best response to each question.

paragraphs.text: Directions: You will hear some conversations between two or more people. You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speakers say in each conversation. Select the best response to each question and mark the letter (A), (B), (C), or (D) on your answer sheet. The conversations will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.

What does the woman imply about the alterations?

options.label: They will cost more than expected.
They can be completed before the wedding.
They must be paid for in advance.

options.label: To deliver the jacket to his home

parts.title: Talks
parts.instructions: Select the best response to each question.

paragraphs.text: Directions: You will hear some talks given by a single speaker. You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speaker says in each talk. Select the best response to each question and mark the letter (A), (B), (C), or (D) on your answer sheet. The talks will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.

questions.prompt: What type of business does the speaker most likely work for?
What good news does the speaker announce?

options.label: It will exhibit at a trade show.
It has won a business award.
It plans to hire more staff.
It has opened a new office.

questions.prompt: What are the listeners asked to do before Friday?

options.label: Reserve a booth at the exhibition
Indicate the days they can work

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say she likes most about the blender?
What is required in order to get the discount?
What does the speaker encourage the listeners to do?
Who most likely is the speaker?
What does the speaker ask the listener to provide?

options.label: A code for the main entrance
A key to the front offices
A way to get the crew inside

questions.prompt: What does the speaker imply when she says, "we're fully booked all next week, and our next open evening isn't until month's end"?

options.label: A later visit could be difficult to schedule
The company will assign additional crews
The first visit will occur at month's end
The listener will owe an extra charge

questions.prompt: Where most likely is the talk being given?
What type of organization does the speaker represent?
What does the speaker encourage listeners to do?

options.label: Try out the new rail service

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the speech?

options.label: To review the company's production figures

To announce a change in management

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say is the main advantage of the program?

options.label: One-on-one advice from a senior coworker

questions.prompt: According to the speaker, what should employees do to enroll in the program?

options.label: Submit a form to human resources

questions.prompt: Who most likely are the listeners?
What will the group do outside?
What will happen at the end of the evening?

options.label: A printed guide will be handed out.

The prices will rise later in the day.
